mapper.select: SELECT id, meeting_id as meetingId, created_by as createdBy, title, amount, description, receipt_url as receiptUrl, status, created_at as createdAt, approved_at as approvedAt FROM woorido.expense_requests WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT er.id AS EXPENSE_ID, m.challenge_id AS CHALLENGE_ID, er.meeting_id AS MEETING_ID, er.created_by AS CREATED_BY, u.nickname AS CREATED_BY_NICKNAME, u.profile_image_url AS CREATED_BY_PROFILE_IMAGE, er.title AS TITLE, er.amount AS AMOUNT, er.description AS DESCRIPTION, er.receipt_url AS RECEIPT_URL, er.status AS STATUS, er.created_at AS CREATED_AT, er.approved_at AS APPROVED_AT FROM woorido.expense_requests er JOIN woorido.meetings m ON er.meeting_id = m.id LEFT JOIN woorido.users u ON er.created_by = u.id WHERE er.id = #{id} AND m.challenge_id = #{challengeId}
